Secondary_Symptoms: Postural lightheadedness; Association with fatigue, dehydration, anxiety, anemia, or medication side-effects; Palpitations; General weakness
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Chakkar ghoomne waala (rotational vertigo) hai ya sirdard/dhimapan/chakar-aana jaisa faint lagta hai?; 2. Khade hone par achanak badhta hai?; 3. BP, hemoglobin, ya sugar test hua hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Correct Underlying Cause + Hydration & Electrolytes / Paracetamol (if associated headache)
Supportive_Medicines: Iron & Folic Acid (if anemic); Adjusting antihypertensive drugs (under doctor if orthostatic hypotension); Reassurance
Precautions_Contraindications: Do not routinely prescribe vestibular suppressants (Betahistine/Cinnarizine) for non-vestibular lightheadedness. Evaluate and correct underlying physical causes: orthostatic hypotension, dehydration, anemia, hypoglycemia, arrhythmia, or medication side effects (antihypertensives, sedatives). Never stop prescribed cardiovascular medications on your own
Home_Care_Advice: Stand up slowly from lying or sitting positions (sit on bed edge for 30 seconds before standing); Maintain high daily fluid intake (2-3 liters); Eat small frequent meals; Avoid sudden head tilting or prolonged fasting
Lab_Investigations: Complete Blood Count (rule out anemia); Fasting Blood Glucose; Lying and Standing Blood Pressure (check for Orthostatic Hypotension - drop >20 mmHg systolic); ECG; Serum Electrolytes
Emergency_Red_Flags: Syncope / Loss of consciousness; Chest pain or irregular rapid palpitations; Focal neurological deficits (speech slurring, arm weakness); Black tarry stools (GI bleeding)

Primary_Symptoms: INSIDIOUS ONSET of persistent dull headache, progressive confusion, cognitive decline, gait unsteadiness, and focal weakness weeks after MINOR HEAD TRAUMA in elderly
Secondary_Symptoms: Fluctuating consciousness; Hemiparesis (often mimicking stroke); Personality changes; Memory impairment; History of minor fall 2-6 weeks prior; Anticoagulant use
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kuch hafte pehle koi chhoti chot ya girna hua tha?; 2. Tab se sirdard, bhoolna, chalne me ladkhadahat, ya haath-pair me kamzori badh rahi hai?; 3. Blood thinner (Aspirin/Warfarin) chal rahi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: None - emergency hospital referral
Popular_Indian_Brands: Injection Mannitol IV + Emergency Surgical Burr-Hole Evacuation
Dosage_Frequency: Immediate emergency neurosurgical referral for Burr-Hole Evacuation
Supportive_Medicines: Immediate ER / Neurosurgery Admission; Urgent Non-Contrast CT Brain; Reversal of anticoagulation; Emergency Surgical Burr-Hole Evacuation under local/general anesthesia
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Life-threatening neurosurgical emergency. STOP ALL BLOOD THINNERS (Aspirin, Clopidogrel, Warfarin, DOACs) IMMEDIATELY upon suspicion. Do NOT give painkillers or sedatives at home
Home_Care_Advice: Immediate emergency transfer to tertiary neurosurgical hospital; Keep patient resting with head elevated 30 degrees; Do NOT give anything by mouth
Lab_Investigations: Emergency Non-Contrast CT Brain (Gold standard - shows crescent-shaped hypodense or isodense extra-axial fluid collection compressing brain parenchyma); Coagulation Profile (PT/INR, APTT); Complete Blood Count
Emergency_Red_Flags: Emergency Red Flags: Rapid drop in consciousness / coma; Progressive hemiparesis; Anisocoria (unequal pupils); Repeated vomiting; Post-traumatic seizures

Primary_Symptoms: PROGRESSIVE BILATERAL LEG WEAKNESS, SENSORY LEVEL (numbness below a specific spinal level), GAIT ATAXIA, and BLADDER/BOWEL DYSFUNCTION
Secondary_Symptoms: Severe localized spinal pain; Spasticity; Hyperreflexia; Positive Babinski sign; Sphincter disturbance (urinary retention/overflow incontinence)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Dono pairo me kamzori, chalne me ladkhadahat, aur chhati/peth ke neeche sunn-pan aaya hai?; 2. Peshab/latrine ka control khoy gaya hai ya peshab ruka hai?; 3. Spine me tez dard hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: None - emergency hospital referral
Popular_Indian_Brands: Injection Methylprednisolone IV + Emergency Surgical Decompression
Dosage_Frequency: Immediate emergency transfer for Surgical Decompression
Supportive_Medicines: Immediate ER / Spine Surgery Admission; Emergency MRI Whole Spine; High-dose IV Methylprednisolone (if traumatic); Surgical Laminectomy / Decompression within 24-48 hours
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Critical life-threatening orthopedic/neurosurgical emergency with high risk of permanent paraplegia/quadriplegia. DO NOT ATTEMPT MANIPULATION, MASSAGE, OR PHYSICAL THERAPY. Keep spine strictly immobilized
Home_Care_Advice: Immediate emergency transfer to tertiary spine surgery center; Transport lying completely flat on a rigid spinal board; Do NOT allow patient to sit, stand, or bend spine; Do NOT give anything by mouth
Lab_Investigations: Emergency MRI Whole Spine with Contrast (Gold standard - confirms site and etiology of cord compression: disc, tumor, epidural abscess, fracture); Plain X-rays Spine
Emergency_Red_Flags: Emergency Red Flags: Loss of urinary or bowel control; Progressive bilateral leg paralysis; Sensory level impairment below chest/abdomen; Sudden trauma

Primary_Symptoms: PENTAD: 1. SEVERE EXCESSIVE DAYTIME SLEEPINESS (EDS / irresistible sleep attacks), 2. CATAPLEXY (sudden loss of muscle tone triggered by emotion like laughter)
Secondary_Symptoms: Hypnagogic/hypnopompic hallucinations (vivid dream-like imagery when falling asleep/waking); Sleep paralysis; Fragmented night sleep; Automatic behavior
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Din me achanak bina control ke tez neend ke doure (sleep attacks) aate hain?; 2. Hasne, naatak karne, ya gussa hone par achanak ghutne ya chehre ki manspeshiya dhili (cataplexy) ho jati hain?; 3. Sleep paralysis hota hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - specialist supervision required (Modafinil / Armodafinil / Solriamfetol / Sodium Oxybate / Pitolisant under Sleep Specialist)
Supportive_Medicines: Venlafaxine / Fluoxetine (for cataplexy under specialist); Scheduled daytime naps; Sleep hygiene guidance
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 200 mg Modafinil initial / 150 mg Armodafinil initial
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - specialist supervision required. Modafinil, Armodafinil, and Sodium Oxybate are Rx central nervous system stimulants / scheduled drugs; NEVER STOP OR CHANGE THE DOSE ON YOUR OWN. Modafinil reduces the efficacy of oral contraceptive pills (requires barrier contraception). Monitor blood pressure and heart rate regularly. Risk of severe cutaneous rash (SJS)
Home_Care_Advice: Schedule 2-3 planned 15-20 minute daytime naps at regular intervals; Maintain strict consistent nighttime sleep-wake schedule; Strictly avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until excessive daytime sleepiness is completely controlled
Lab_Investigations: Polysomnography (PSG - overnight sleep study); Multiple Sleep Latency Test (MSLT - shows mean sleep latency <8 mins and ≥2 SOREMPs); HLA-DQB1*06:02 gene testing; CSF Orexin/Hypocretin-1 level
Emergency_Red_Flags: Sudden sleep attack while driving or operating machinery causing accidents; Severe depression; Severe rash with fever (SJS warning)

Primary_Symptoms: Difficulty initiating sleep, maintaining sleep, or early morning awakening occurring at least 3 nights per week for >3 months, causing daytime impairment
Secondary_Symptoms: Daytime fatigue; Irritability; Mood disturbance; Impaired concentration; Anxiety regarding sleep performance; Muscle tension
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Neend aane me, baar-baar khulne me, ya subah jaldi neend tootne me dikkat 3 mahine se zyada se hai?; 2. Din me thakan aur chidchidapan rehta hai?; 3. Chai/coffee ya screen kitna use karte hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Insomnia (CBT-I) FIRST-LINE + Sleep Hygiene (NO LONG-TERM SLEEPING PILLS)
Dosage_Frequency: OD (Taken strictly at bedtime under short-term doctor guidance)
Duration_Days: Short-term only (3 to 7 days for hypnotic drugs)
Supportive_Medicines: Melatonin 3 mg at bedtime (doctor-guided); CBT-I therapy program; Sleep hygiene optimization
Precautions_Contraindications: NON-PHARMACOLOGICAL CBT-I IS THE FIRST-LINE GOLD STANDARD TREATMENT. Hypnotics and sedative-hypnotics (Zolpidem, Benzodiazepines like Clonazepam/Alprazolam) ARE RX ONLY, RESTRICTED STRICTLY TO SHORT-TERM USE (3-7 DAYS MAXIMUM) for acute distress. CAUTION: HIGH RISK OF DRUG DEPENDENCE, TOLERANCE, REBOUND INSOMNIA, FALLS IN ELDERLY, AND MORNING DROWSIER DRIVING IMPAIRMENT. NEVER STOP SLEEPING PILLS ABRUPTLY. Do NOT list OTC sedatives as a long-term solution. Melatonin may be used as doctor-guided
Home_Care_Advice: Practice strict Sleep Hygiene: 1. Keep a fixed sleep and wake time every day; 2. Avoid all screens (mobile, TV, laptop) 1 hour before bed; 3. Use bed strictly for sleep and intimacy only (get out of bed if unable to sleep after 20 mins); 4. Avoid caffeine, tea, nicotine, and alcohol after 4 PM; 5. Keep bedroom dark, quiet, and cool
Lab_Investigations: Polysomnography (PSG - if sleep apnea or restless legs suspected); Serum B12; Thyroid Profile (TSH); Fasting Blood Glucose
Emergency_Red_Flags: Severe depression with suicidal ideation; Severe daytime somnolence causing motor accidents; Paradoxical agitation or nocturnal wandering

Common_Names_Hindi: Shift Work Sleep Disorder; Night shift neend ki dikkat
Primary_Symptoms: Insomnia and excessive daytime sleepiness directly aligned with working non-traditional hours (night shifts, rotating shifts, or early morning shifts)
Secondary_Symptoms: Chronic fatigue; Impaired work performance; Irritability; Gastrointestinal distress; Sleep onset difficulty during day; Accidents
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Night shift ya rotating shifts me kaam karne ke karan neend toot ti hai?; 2. Din me sote waqt neend aane me dikkat aur kaam par tez neend aati hai?; 3. Kitne mahine se night shift kar rahe hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Sleep Hygiene & Circadian Adaptation + Melatonin / Modafinil (Doctor-guided)
Dosage_Frequency: OD (Melatonin 30 mins before daytime sleep) / OD (Modafinil before night shift)
Duration_Days: As per shift schedule under doctor guidance
Supportive_Medicines: Blackout curtains; Eye mask and earplugs; Scheduled short naps before shift
Precautions_Contraindications: Non-pharmacological light management and circadian adjustment are first-line. Prescription wakefulness agents (Modafinil) or short-term hypnotics/melatonin are Rx only under doctor guidance. Dependence and tolerance caution for prescription sedatives. Never stop or change medications on your own
Home_Care_Advice: Wear dark sunglasses when driving home in morning sunlight post-night shift; Use blackout curtains, eye masks, and earplugs to create a dark, quiet daytime sleep environment; Take a 20-30 minute caffeine-nap before starting night shift; Maintain consistent sleep schedules on off-days as much as possible
Lab_Investigations: Polysomnography (if co-existing obstructive sleep apnea suspected); Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS); Circadian evaluation
Emergency_Red_Flags: Severe somnolence while driving home from night shift causing near-miss accidents; Depression with suicidal thoughts; Severe metabolic syndrome

Primary_Symptoms: Presence of multiple MOTOR TICS (rapid, recurrent, non-rhythmic muscle twitches like eye blinking, shoulder shrugging) AND/OR VOCAL TICS (throat clearing, grunting)
Secondary_Symptoms: Premonitory urge prior to tic; Suppressibility for short periods followed by rebound burst; Co-existing ADHD or OCD; Anxiety; Social impairment
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Achanak bina control ke sharir ke hisse hiltay (motor tics) ya aawaazein (vocal tics) nikalti hain?; 2. Tic karne se pehle andar se khichav/urge mehsoos hoti hai?; 3. Kitni umar se shuru hua?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - specialist supervision required (Comprehensive Behavioral Intervention for Tics - CBIT FIRST-LINE / Alpha-2 Agonists - Clonidine / Antipsychotics - Aripiprazole / Risperidone)
Supportive_Medicines: Behavioral therapy (CBIT - Habit Reversal Training); Psychoeducation for school/family; Treatment of co-existing ADHD/OCD
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - specialist supervision required. All pharmacotherapy (Clonidine, Aripiprazole, Risperidone, Haloperidol) ARE RX ONLY under pediatric neurologist / psychiatrist supervision. NEVER STOP OR CHANGE DOSES ON YOUR OWN. Clonidine requires BP and heart rate monitoring; do not stop abruptly (rebound hypertension). Antipsychotics require monitoring for weight gain, metabolic syndrome, extrapyramidal symptoms, and tardive dyskinesia
Home_Care_Advice: Provide a supportive, non-judgmental environment; DO NOT REPRIMAND, PUNISH, OR CONSTANTLY CORRECT THE CHILD FOR TICS (stress and scolding increase tic frequency); Educate teachers and peers to prevent bullying; Practice stress relaxation
Lab_Investigations: Clinical evaluation (Yale Global Tic Severity Scale); EEG (rule out myoclonic seizures); Thyroid Profile; Serum Ferritin
Emergency_Red_Flags: Tic status (continuous severe violent tics causing self-injury like neck whiplash or lip biting); Sudden severe behavioral crisis or suicidal distress

Primary_Symptoms: PERSISTENT LOW MOOD, LOSS OF INTEREST OR PLEASURE (ANHEDONIA) IN ACTIVITIES FOR AT LEAST 2 WEEKS, accompanied by fatigue and low energy
Secondary_Symptoms: Changes in appetite/weight; Insomnia or hypersomnia; Worthlessness or excessive guilt; Impaired concentration; Psychomotor agitation or retardation
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya kam se kam 2 hafte se man udaas rehta hai aur pehle pasand aane waali cheezon me dil nahi lagta?; 2. Thakan, neend, ya bhookh me badlav aaya hai?; 3. Koi khud ko nuksan pahunchane ke khayal to nahi aate?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Psychotherapy (CBT) FIRST-LINE + SSRIs (Sertraline / Escitalopram / Fluoxetine under Doctor)
Duration_Days: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (6 to 12 months)
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT); Interpersonal Therapy; Structured daily physical activity; Lifestyle modification
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 50 mg Sertraline initial / 10 mg Escitalopram initial / 20 mg Fluoxetine initial
Precautions_Contraindications: Psychotherapy and lifestyle modifications come first for mild cases. SSRIs/SNRIs are Rx only under medical supervision. IMPORTANT SAFETY WARNINGS: 1. SSRIs take 2 to 4 weeks to display therapeutic antidepressant effect; 2. SSRIs MAY TRANSIENTLY INCREASE SUICIDAL IDEATION/THOUGHTS IN CHILDREN, ADOLESCENTS, AND YOUNG ADULTS UNDER AGE 25 DURING THE FIRST FEW WEEKS OF TREATMENT; 3. NEVER STOP OR CHANGE THE DOSE ON YOUR OWN (abrupt cessation causes antidepressant discontinuation syndrome); 4. SSRIs interact significantly with Tramadol, Triptans, Linezolid, MAOIs, and other serotonergic drugs (Serotonin Syndrome risk). Benzodiazepines for acute anxiety are Rx and short-term only
Home_Care_Advice: Engage in regular aerobic exercise (brisk walking 30 mins daily); Maintain consistent sleep-wake routines; Stay connected with supportive family and friends; Avoid isolation; Avoid alcohol and recreational drugs
Lab_Investigations: Complete Blood Count; Thyroid Profile (TSH - MUST RULE OUT HYPOTHYROIDISM); Serum B12 & Vitamin D; Fasting Blood Glucose
Emergency_Red_Flags: Emergency Red Flags: Onset of suicidal thoughts, plans, or self-harm urges; Psychotic symptoms (hallucinations/delusions); Complete inability to perform basic self-care

Primary_Symptoms: SEVERE UNREMITTING LOW MOOD, PROFOUND ANHEDONIA, PROFOUND FATIGUE, INABILITY TO FUNCTION, WITH OR WITHOUT PSYCHOTIC FEATURES OR ACTIVE SUICIDAL INTENT
Secondary_Symptoms: Active suicidal ideation/intent; Psychotic delusions (nihilistic, guilt, somatizing) or hallucinations; Severe psychomotor retardation or stupor; Significant weight loss
Typical_Duration: Months to ongoing until structured treatment
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya udaasi itni severe hai ki daily kaam bilkul nahi ho pa rahe?; 2. Man me jeene ki ichha khatam hone ya suicide ke khayal aate hain?; 3. Aawaazein sunai dena ya shakk hona to nahi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (SSRIs / SNRIs - Escitalopram / Venlafaxine / Mirtazapine / Augmentation / ECT Evaluation)
Dosage_Frequency: OD (Morning for Escitalopram/Venlafaxine; Bedtime for Mirtazapine)
Duration_Days: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (12 to 24 months)
Supportive_Medicines: Combination Pharmacotherapy; Psychotherapy (CBT); Electroconvulsive Therapy (ECT - for refractory/catatonic severe cases under specialist); Crisis Safety Plan
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 20 mg Escitalopram / 225 mg Venlafaxine / 45 mg Mirtazapine
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required. NEVER STOP OR CHANGE DOSES ON YOUR OWN. SSRIs/SNRIs take 2-4 weeks to work and may temporarily increase suicidal thoughts in patients under 25 in initial weeks. Never combine with MAOIs, Tramadol, or Triptans without specialist oversight. High suicide risk requires immediate psychiatric crisis intervention and safety measures
Home_Care_Advice: Ensure 24/7 adult supervision and support; Remove all means of self-harm (medications, sharp objects) from home environment; Accompany patient to all psychiatric appointments; Ensure strict adherence to prescribed psychiatric regimen
Lab_Investigations: Thyroid Profile (TSH); Serum B12 & Folate; Complete Blood Count; Fasting Blood Glucose; Liver & Renal Function Tests
Emergency_Red_Flags: EMERGENCY RED FLAGS: Active suicidal plans, intent, or suicide note preparation; Self-harm attempt; Severe catatonia (not eating/drinking/moving); Psychotic agitation

Primary_Symptoms: CHRONIC DEPRESSED MOOD OCCURRING FOR MOST OF THE DAY, FOR MORE DAYS THAN NOT, FOR AT LEAST 2 YEARS (1 year in children/adolescents)
Secondary_Symptoms: Poor appetite or overeating; Insomnia or hypersomnia; Low energy or fatigue; Low self-esteem; Poor concentration; Feelings of hopelessness
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya pichle 2 saal se zyada samay se man zyadatar udaas aur khali rehta hai?; 2. Aisa lagta hai ki ye aapki personality ka hissa ban gaya hai?; 3. Severe depression ke spells beech me aaye hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Psychotherapy (CBT / CBASP) FIRST-LINE + SSRIs (Sertraline / Escitalopram under Psychiatrist)
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive Behavioral Analysis System of Psychotherapy (CBASP); Psychotherapy; Lifestyle activation
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 50 mg Sertraline initial / 10 mg Escitalopram initial
Precautions_Contraindications: Psychotherapy and lifestyle activation are primary long-term modalities. SSRIs/SNRIs are Rx only under psychiatrist supervision. Never stop or change medication doses on your own. SSRIs take 2-4 weeks to show effectiveness and require gradual doctor-guided tapering when discontinuing. Monitor for suicidal thoughts in young adults
Home_Care_Advice: Engage in long-term psychotherapy; Establish a structured daily routine with regular physical exercise and social activities; Practice cognitive reframing; Avoid alcohol or self-medication
Lab_Investigations: Thyroid Profile (TSH); Serum B12 & Vitamin D; Complete Blood Count; Fasting Blood Glucose
Emergency_Red_Flags: Onset of active suicidal thoughts or self-harm urges; Escalation into a Major Depressive Episode ('Double Depression'); Psychotic features

Common_Names_Hindi: Stress ke baad udaasi; Adjustment Disorder
Primary_Symptoms: Emotional or behavioral symptoms (anxiety, depressed mood, disturbance of conduct) IN RESPONSE TO AN IDENTIFIABLE PSYCHOSOCIAL STRESSOR, developing within 3 months
Secondary_Symptoms: Excessive distress out of proportion to severity of stressor; Significant impairment in social, occupational, or academic functioning; Worry; Insomnia
Typical_Duration: Resolves within 6 months after stressor or its consequences cease
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kisi badi ghatna (job loss, break-up, shift, loss) ke baad 3 mahine ke andar udaasi ya ghabrahat shuru hui hai?; 2. Kaam ya daily life par kitna asar pad raha hai?; 3. Suicidal thoughts to nahi hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Psychotherapy (Supportive / CBT) FIRST-LINE (MEDICATIONS NOT ROUTINELY REQUIRED)
Popular_Indian_Brands: Nexito 5 (Short-term SOS if severe under doctor); Zapiz 0.25 (Short-term SOS)
Dosage_Frequency: OD or SOS short-term under doctor
Duration_Days: Short-term only (2 to 4 weeks if meds used)
Supportive_Medicines: Supportive Psychotherapy; Stress Management Skills; Problem-solving counseling; Sleep hygiene
Precautions_Contraindications: PSYCHOTHERAPY AND COUNSELING ARE THE FIRST-LINE TREATMENT. Routine long-term psychiatric drug therapy is NOT indicated for simple Adjustment Disorder. Short-term low-dose SSRIs or benzodiazepines are Rx only under doctor guidance for acute disabling insomnia/anxiety (max 1-2 weeks). Never stop or change prescribed medicines on your own
Home_Care_Advice: Seek professional counseling or supportive therapy; Utilize personal support systems (talk to trusted family/friends); Learn problem-solving and coping strategies; Practice mindfulness and relaxation exercises
Lab_Investigations: Basic medical screening (TSH, CBC, Glucose) to rule out physical causes of fatigue/anxiety
Emergency_Red_Flags: Active suicidal ideation or self-harm gestures; Severe incapacitating panic or depression; Substance abuse escalation

Common_Names_Hindi: Achanak ghabrahat / Panic Attacks; Panic Disorder
Primary_Symptoms: RECURRENT UNEXPECTED PANIC ATTACKS (sudden surges of intense fear reaching a peak within minutes), followed by persistent worry about future attacks
Secondary_Symptoms: Palpitations; Trembling; Shortness of breath; Choking sensation; Chest pain; Nausea; Dizziness; Derealization/Depersonalization; Fear of losing control or dying
Typical_Duration: Chronic condition with episodic panic surges
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Achanak bina kisi vajah ke tez ghabrahat, dil ki dhadkan tez, saans phoolna, aur marne/paagal hone ka darr lagta hai?; 2. Ye attack 10-20 minute me peak par pahunchta hai?; 3. Baar-baar aisa hone ka darr rehta hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Psychotherapy (CBT) FIRST-LINE + SSRIs (Sertraline / Escitalopram / Paroxetine under Psychiatrist)
Duration_Days: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (6 to 12 months)
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT with interoceptive exposure); Short-term SOS Benzodiazepine (Clonazepam 0.25 mg SOS for acute severe attacks under strict limit)
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 50 mg Sertraline initial / 10 mg Escitalopram initial
Precautions_Contraindications: CBT is first-line non-pharmacological gold standard. SSRIs/SNRIs are Rx only; take 2-4 weeks to display full anti-panic efficacy and may transiently increase anxiety in first week (start at low dose). NEVER STOP OR CHANGE DOSES ON YOUR OWN. Benzodiazepines (Clonazepam, Alprazolam) are Rx only, restricted to short-term SOS use due to high dependence and addiction risk. Avoid caffeine and stimulants
Home_Care_Advice: Learn interoceptive exposure and slow diaphragmatic breathing techniques (4-7-8 breathing); During an attack, remind yourself: 'This is a panic attack, it is temporary, uncomfortable but NOT life-threatening, and will pass in a few minutes'; Do not avoid places where attacks occurred
Lab_Investigations: ECG (MUST RULE OUT CARDIAC ARRHYTHMIA/ISCHEMIA DURING FIRST EPISODE); Thyroid Profile (TSH - rule out hyperthyroidism); Fasting Blood Glucose; CBC
Emergency_Red_Flags: Chest pain radiating to arm/jaw with diaphoresis (MUST RULE OUT ACUTE MYOCARDIAL INFARCTION); Persistent suicidal ideation; Severe agoraphobic confinement

Common_Names_Hindi: Logon se darr / Social Phobia; Social Anxiety
Primary_Symptoms: MARKED, PERSISTENT FEAR OR ANXIETY ABOUT ONE OR MORE SOCIAL SITUATIONS where the individual is exposed to potential scrutiny by others
Secondary_Symptoms: Fear of acting in a way that will be negatively evaluated (humiliated/embarrassed); Blushing; Trembling; Sweating; Tachycardia; Avoidance of social interactions
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Logon ke samne bolne, milne, khana khane, ya stage par jane me tez darr aur ghabrahat hoti hai?; 2. Aisa lagta hai sab aapko judge/insult karenge?; 3. Social situations ko avoid karte hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Psychotherapy (CBT) FIRST-LINE + SSRIs (Sertraline / Escitalopram / Paroxetine under Psychiatrist)
Duration_Days: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (6 to 12 months)
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT with social exposure); Propranolol 10-20 mg (taken 30-60 mins before performance for physical symptoms under doctor)
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 50 mg Sertraline initial / 10 mg Escitalopram initial
Precautions_Contraindications: CBT is the first-line long-term modality. SSRIs/SNRIs are Rx only under psychiatrist supervision. Take 2-4 weeks to show therapeutic response; never stop or change doses on your own. Propranolol for performance anxiety is Rx only; CONTRAINDICATED IN ASTHMA, sinus bradycardia, and heart block. Benzodiazepines short-term only
Home_Care_Advice: Engage in gradual exposure therapy (practice social interactions step-by-step without avoiding); Challenge catastrophic negative thoughts ('People will laugh at me'); Join social skills training or support groups; Avoid alcohol or drugs as coping mechanisms
Lab_Investigations: Thyroid Profile (TSH); Fasting Blood Glucose; Basic Medical Examination
Emergency_Red_Flags: Severe social isolation and incapacitation; Co-existing major depression with active suicidal thoughts; Substance dependence

Common_Names_Hindi: Khas cheez se darr; Specific Phobia
Primary_Symptoms: MARKED, UNREASONABLE FEAR OR ANXIETY ABOUT A SPECIFIC OBJECT OR SITUATION (e.g., heights, animals, blood/injections, flying, enclosed spaces)
Secondary_Symptoms: Immediate anxiety response upon exposure; Active avoidance of phobic stimulus; Panic-like symptoms; Vasovagal syncope (specifically in blood-injection-injury phobia)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kisi khas cheez (unchai, kutta, sui, ya band jagah) se tez darr lagta hai?; 2. Us cheez ke samne aate hi tez ghabrahat hoti hai?; 3. Daily life kitni disturb hoti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Exposure Therapy / Systematic Desensitization FIRST-LINE (ORAL MEDICATIONS ARE NOT ROUTINELY INDICATED)
Popular_Indian_Brands: Zapiz 0.25 (Short-term SOS before unavoidable exposure under doctor)
Dosage_Frequency: Single dose 30-60 mins before unavoidable exposure
Supportive_Medicines: In-Vivo Exposure Therapy; Systematic Desensitization; Applied Tension technique (for blood-injection phobia)
Precautions_Contraindications: BEHAVIORAL EXPOSURE THERAPY IS THE GOLD STANDARD FIRST-LINE TREATMENT. Daily oral psychiatric medications are NOT indicated or effective for simple specific phobias. Short-term benzodiazepines or beta-blockers may be prescribed strictly SOS by a doctor for acute unavoidable exposures (e.g., necessary air travel or dental procedure). Never self-medicate
Home_Care_Advice: Undergo structured exposure therapy under a clinical psychologist; Practice gradual step-by-step exposure hierarchy; Use deep breathing relaxation during exposure; Learn 'applied tension' (muscle tensing) for blood/injection phobia to prevent fainting
Lab_Investigations: Basic Medical Evaluation (if vasovagal syncope occurs)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Severe functional impairment preventing essential medical care (e.g., avoiding life-saving injections/surgery); Panic attacks causing injury

Primary_Symptoms: MARKED FEAR OR ANXIETY ABOUT BEING IN SITUATIONS WHERE ESCAPE MIGHT BE DIFFICULT OR HELP UNAVAILABLE if panic symptoms develop
Secondary_Symptoms: Fear of using public transportation, open spaces, enclosed spaces, standing in line, or being in a crowd; Active avoidance requiring a companion; Housebound in severe cases
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Bheed, public transport, ya ghar se door jane me tez darr lagta hai ki panic hone par help nahi milegi?; 2. Akele bahar jane se bachte hain ya kisi ko sath le jana padta hai?; 3. Ghar se nikalna band ho gaya hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Psychotherapy (CBT with Exposure) FIRST-LINE + SSRIs (Sertraline / Escitalopram under Psychiatrist)
Duration_Days: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (6 to 12 months)
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT with systematic situational exposure); Short-term SOS Benzodiazepine (under strict doctor limit)
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 50 mg Sertraline initial / 10 mg Escitalopram initial
Precautions_Contraindications: CBT with graded situational exposure is the most effective long-term treatment. SSRIs are Rx only under psychiatrist supervision. Take 2-4 weeks to display full therapeutic response; never stop or change doses on your own. Benzodiazepines Rx only, restricted to short-term SOS use to prevent avoidance reinforcement
Home_Care_Advice: Perform gradual in-vivo exposure exercises (start by stepping outside home, then walking down street, gradually increasing distance); Practice slow diaphragmatic breathing; Maintain regular daily routines
Lab_Investigations: Thyroid Profile (TSH); Fasting Blood Glucose; ECG
Emergency_Red_Flags: Complete housebound state leading to severe self-neglect; Severe depression with active suicidal ideation

Primary_Symptoms: PRESENCE OF OBSESSIONS (recurrent, intrusive, unwanted thoughts, urges, or images causing anxiety) AND/OR COMPULSIONS (repetitive behaviors performed to reduce anxiety)
Secondary_Symptoms: Common obsessions: contamination, doubt/harm, symmetry; Common compulsions: washing/handwashing, checking, counting, ordering; Significant time consumption (>1 hour/day)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Dimaag me baar-baar unwanted khayal/darr (obsessions) aate hain jo rokne par bhi nahi rukte?; 2. Unhe shaant karne ke liye baar-baar haath dhoona, check karna, ya ginte rehna (compulsions) padta hai?; 3. Isme kitna time kharab hota hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) Psychotherapy FIRST-LINE + High-dose SSRIs (Fluoxetine / Sertraline / Fluvoxamine / Clomipramine under Psychiatrist)
Dosage_Frequency: OD or divided BD under Psychiatrist
Duration_Days: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (12 to 24 months)
Supportive_Medicines: Behavioral Therapy (ERP); Clomipramine (TCA second-line under specialist); Augmentation with low-dose Antipsychotics (Aripiprazole / Risperidone)
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 80 mg Fluoxetine / 200 mg Sertraline / 300 mg Fluvoxamine / 225 mg Clomipramine
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required. OCD typically requires HIGH-DOSE SSRI THERAPY and longer duration (8-12 weeks) to demonstrate clinical response compared to depression. NEVER STOP OR CHANGE DOSES ON YOUR OWN; abrupt cessation causes severe OCD relapse. Clomipramine (TCA) requires ECG monitoring for QT prolongation and anticholinergic precautions. Monitor for serotonin syndrome
Home_Care_Advice: Undergo cognitive behavioral therapy with Exposure and Response Prevention (ERP) under a specialist; Practice resisting compulsions gradually ('delaying handwashing by 5 minutes'); Involve family to stop reassurance-seeking
Lab_Investigations: Complete Blood Count; Thyroid Profile (TSH); ECG (if Clomipramine prescribed); Fasting Blood Glucose
Emergency_Red_Flags: Severe skin breakdown or bleeding from excessive handwashing; Severe depression with suicidal ideation; Inability to eat or perform basic self-care

Common_Names_Hindi: Trauma ke baad ka darr; PTSD
Primary_Symptoms: DEVELOPMENT OF CHARACTERISTIC SYMPTOMS FOLLOWING EXPOSURE TO A TRAUMATIC EVENT (actual or threatened death, serious injury, or sexual violence)
Secondary_Symptoms: Intrusive memories / Flashbacks / Nightmares; Avoidance of trauma-related stimuli; Negative alterations in cognitions and mood; Hyperarousal and hypervigilance; Exaggerated startle response
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kisi badi chot, accident, ya traumatic ghatna ke baad baar-baar uske flashbacks, sapne, ya darr aata hai?; 2. Traumatic jagah ya baato se bachte hain?; 3. Achanak chauankna (startle) ya gussa aata hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Trauma-Focused Psychotherapy (TF-CBT / EMDR) FIRST-LINE + SSRIs (Sertraline / Paroxetine under Psychiatrist)
Duration_Days: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (6 to 12 months)
Supportive_Medicines: Trauma-Focused CBT; Eye Movement Desensitization and Reprocessing (EMDR); Prazosin 1-2 mg at bedtime (alpha-blocker for traumatic nightmares under doctor)
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 100 mg Sertraline initial / 25 mg Paroxetine initial
Precautions_Contraindications: Trauma-focused psychotherapy (TF-CBT, EMDR) is the most effective primary treatment. SSRIs (Sertraline, Paroxetine) are Rx only under psychiatrist supervision. Take 2-4 weeks to show benefit; never stop or change doses on your own. Prazosin (alpha-1 blocker) for nightmares requires monitoring for orthostatic hypotension. Benzodiazepines are NOT recommended for PTSD (impair trauma extinction processing)
Home_Care_Advice: Undergo EMDR or Trauma-Focused CBT with a qualified therapist; Practice grounding techniques during flashbacks (5-4-3-2-1 sensory awareness); Maintain physical safety and social support; Avoid self-medicating with alcohol
Lab_Investigations: Basic medical evaluation (TSH, CBC); Substance use screening
Emergency_Red_Flags: Active suicidal thoughts or plans; Severe dissociation; Substance abuse escalation; Severe panic or violent outbursts

Common_Names_Hindi: Trauma ke turant baad ka stress; Acute Stress Reaction
Primary_Symptoms: Transient emotional and behavioral reaction developing IMMEDIATELY TO WITHIN 1 MONTH of exposure to an exceptional physical or psychological stressor
Secondary_Symptoms: Dazed state; Anxiety; Depression; Anger; Despair; Overactivity or withdrawal; Symptoms typically subside within hours or a few days
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kisi accident ya sudden shock ke turant baad ghabrahat, dazed feel hona, ya sunn-pan hua hai?; 2. Kitne din hue hain ghatna ko?; 3. Physical injury to nahi aayi?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Psychological First Aid & Crisis Support FIRST-LINE (MEDICATIONS NOT ROUTINELY INDICATED)
Popular_Indian_Brands: Zapiz 0.25 (Short-term SOS under doctor strictly if severe acute agitation)
Supportive_Medicines: Psychological First Aid (PFA); Reassurance; Physical safety; Rest
Precautions_Contraindications: PSYCHOLOGICAL FIRST AID, SAFETY, AND EMPATHETIC SUPPORT ARE PRIMARY. Routine psychiatric medications are NOT indicated for acute stress reactions. Short-term low-dose benzodiazepine may be prescribed strictly SOS by a doctor for extreme incapacitating panic or agitation (max 1-3 days). Do not force debriefing or trauma processing immediately post-event
Home_Care_Advice: Provide immediate physical safety, quiet environment, and basic needs (food, water, warmth); Offer empathetic listening without forcing detailed retelling of trauma; Utilize family/community support systems; Practice gentle grounding
Lab_Investigations: Basic medical evaluation; Screen for physical trauma or head injury
Emergency_Red_Flags: Active suicidal ideation or severe self-harm urges; Psychotic breakdown; Symptoms persisting beyond 1 month (transition to PTSD)

Common_Names_Hindi: Bimar hone ka darr; Health Anxiety
Primary_Symptoms: PREOCCUPATION WITH HAVING OR ACQUIRING A SERIOUS, LIFE-THREATENING MEDICAL ILLNESS, with absent or minimal somatic symptoms
Secondary_Symptoms: High level of anxiety about health; Excessive health-related behaviors (repeated body checking, doctor shopping, cyberchondria) OR maladaptive avoidance
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya aapko lagta rehta hai ki aapko koi badi bimar (cancer, heart attack) hai, jabki doctor aur reports normal batati hain?; 2. Baar-baar internet par symptoms search karne ya doctor badalne ki aadat hai?; 3. Kitne mahine se hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Psychotherapy (CBT) FIRST-LINE + SSRIs (Escitalopram / Fluoxetine under Psychiatrist)
Duration_Days: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (6 to 12 months)
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT for Health Anxiety); Response prevention for body checking/Googling
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 10 mg Escitalopram initial / 20 mg Fluoxetine initial
Precautions_Contraindications: CBT is the first-line gold standard modality. SSRIs are Rx only under psychiatrist supervision. Take 2-4 weeks to display efficacy; never stop or change doses on your own. Avoid performing unnecessary, repeated invasive medical investigations once physical disease is adequately ruled out by a primary physician
Home_Care_Advice: Undergo CBT to challenge health-catastrophizing beliefs; STRICTLY STOP GOOGLING SYMPTOMS ('Cyberchondria detox'); Limit body checking (checking pulse, scanning skin) to once a week; Stick to one trusted primary care physician
Lab_Investigations: Baseline physical exam, CBC, TSH, Glucose (to rule out underlying organic medical disease ONCE; avoid repetitive duplicate testing)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Co-existing major depression with active suicidal thoughts; Extreme functional disability

Common_Names_Hindi: Sharir me dard/lakshan ka stress; Somatic Symptom Disorder
Primary_Symptoms: ONE OR MORE SOMATIC SYMPTOMS (pain, fatigue, GI distress) that are distressing, accompanied by EXCESSIVE THOUGHTS, FEELINGS, OR BEHAVIORS related to symptoms
Secondary_Symptoms: Persistent high anxiety about somatic symptoms; Disproportionate time and energy devoted to symptoms; Symptoms last >6 months
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Sharir me alag-alag jagah dard/takleef rehti hai jinki koi clear medical vajah nahi milti?; 2. In lakshano ko lekar bahut zyada chinta aur stress rehta hai?; 3. Kitne samay se hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Psychotherapy (CBT) FIRST-LINE + SSRIs / SNRIs (Duloxetine / Amitriptyline under Psychiatrist)
Duration_Days: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (6 to 12 months)
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT); Regularly scheduled primary care visits; Pain management rehabilitation
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 30 mg Duloxetine initial / 25 mg Amitriptyline initial
Precautions_Contraindications: Psychotherapy and a collaborative primary care relationship are central. SSRIs, SNRIs (Duloxetine), and TCAs (Amitriptyline) are Rx only under psychiatrist supervision for co-existing pain/anxiety. Never stop or change doses on your own. Avoid frequent emergency room visits or unnecessary surgeries
Home_Care_Advice: Focus on functional goals (improving daily activity) rather than complete symptom elimination; Schedule brief regular check-ups with a single primary care doctor; Engage in daily gentle physical exercise; Practice stress management
Lab_Investigations: Basic medical workup (CBC, ESR, TSH, Glucose) to rule out occult organic disease; Avoid redundant diagnostic procedures
Emergency_Red_Flags: Active suicidal ideation; Unnecessary invasive surgical procedures; Severe drug dependence on prescription analgesics/sedatives

Common_Names_Hindi: Dimaag-sharir ka reaction; Functional Neurological Disorder
Primary_Symptoms: ONE OR MORE NEUROLOGICAL SYMPTOMS (e.g., non-epileptic seizures, weakness, paralysis, blindness, aphonia) INCOMPATIBLE WITH RECOGNIZED NEUROLOGICAL DISEASE
Secondary_Symptoms: Functional weakness (Hoover's sign positive); Psychogenic Non-Epileptic Seizures (PNES - closed eyes, emotional trigger, preserved pupillary light reflex); Sudden onset post-stress; 'La belle indifférence'
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Achanak haath-pair me lakwa, aakhon se dikhna band, ya behoshi ke doure shuru hue hain?; 2. Medical/MRI reports normal hain par symptom sach me mehsoos hota hai?; 3. Koi emotional stress hua tha?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Multidisciplinary Rehabilitation (Physical Therapy + CBT) FIRST-LINE (NO SPECIFIC CURATIVE DRUG)
Supportive_Medicines: Physical Therapy (Functional retrain); Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT); Reassurance and psychoeducation
Precautions_Contraindications: REASSURANCE AND FUNCTIONAL REPHYSICAL THERAPY ARE FIRST-LINE. Conversion symptoms ARE REAL AND NOT FEIGNED OR 'ACTING'. Do not tell the patient 'it is all in your head'. Psychiatric medications are Rx only for underlying anxiety or depression. Avoid invasive tests once functional diagnosis is confirmed by a neurologist
Home_Care_Advice: Acknowledge that symptoms are genuine while reassuring that brain structure is intact and recovery is possible; Engage in physical therapy focusing on movement automaticity; Undergo CBT to process underlying emotional stressors
Lab_Investigations: Neurological evaluation (Normal EEG during episode confirms PNES; Normal MRI Brain; Positive Hoover's sign for functional weakness)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Severe injury during PNES spell; Co-existing major depression with active suicidal thoughts

Primary_Symptoms: STATE OF VITAL EXHAUSTION CAUSED BY CHRONIC WORKPLACE STRESS THAT HAS NOT BEEN SUCCESSFULLY MANAGED: 1. Exhaustion, 2. Cynicism/Depersonalization, 3. Reduced efficacy
Secondary_Symptoms: Profound fatigue; Negativity toward job; Reduced professional performance; Tension headaches; Sleep disturbance; GI distress
Typical_Duration: Months to ongoing during stressful employment
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kaam ke karan lagataar mental aur physical thakan, chidchidapan, aur kaam se nafrat mehsoos hoti hai?; 2. Rest karne par bhi thakan nahi jaati?; 3. Kitne mahine se hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Lifestyle Redesign & Occupational Stress Management FIRST-LINE (NON-DRUG APPROACH)
Supportive_Medicines: Workplace boundary setting; Counseling; Vacation/leave; Mindful relaxation; Sleep hygiene
Precautions_Contraindications: NON-DRUG APPROACHES ONLY (COUNSELING, WORK BOUNDARIES, SCREEN LIMITS, SOCIAL SUPPORT). No psychiatric medication is indicated or approved for work burnout unless a co-existing clinical disorder (Major Depressive Disorder, Panic Disorder) is formally diagnosed by a doctor
Home_Care_Advice: Set strict work-life boundaries (turn off work emails/phone after office hours); Take structured annual leave/vacation; Delegate tasks; Practice daily exercise and mindfulness meditation; Seek occupational counseling
Lab_Investigations: Basic medical screening (TSH, B12, Hb, Glucose) to rule out medical causes of chronic fatigue
Emergency_Red_Flags: Progression into Major Depressive Disorder with suicidal ideation; Severe alcohol or substance dependence coping

Primary_Symptoms: Transient acute situational anxiety occurring prior to or during examinations, public speaking, or high-stakes performance evaluations
Secondary_Symptoms: Palpitations; Trembling hands; Excessive sweating; Dry mouth; GI upset ('butterflies in stomach'); Cognitive blanking / memory freezing
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Exam ya stage par bolne se pehle tez ghabrahat, dil ki dhadkan, haath kaampna, ya dimaag blank hona hota hai?; 2. Kya ye sirf exam/performance ke waqt hota hai?; 3. Asthma to nahi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Non-Drug Stress Management FIRST-LINE / Propranolol (Rx strictly for physical symptoms under doctor)
Duration_Days: SOS single dose strictly under doctor
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive study planning; Diaphragmatic breathing; Sleep hygiene before exam
Precautions_Contraindications: Non-drug psychological preparation and breathing techniques come first. Propranolol (beta-blocker) is Rx only under doctor guidance for peripheral physical symptoms (palpitations, trembling); STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED IN BRONCHIAL ASTHMA, sinus bradycardia, and heart block. Do NOT take unprescribed sedatives before exams (causes cognitive slowing and memory impairment)
Home_Care_Advice: Maintain regular sleep schedule before exams (AVOID ALL-NIGHTER CRAMMING); Practice timed mock tests; Learn diaphragmatic 4-7-8 breathing; Limit coffee and caffeine intake on exam day
Lab_Investigations: Basic Medical Evaluation (if asthma status uncertain)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Severe panic state with suicidal distress; Fainting/Syncope

Common_Names_Hindi: Grief; Shok / Kisi ko khone ka dukh
Primary_Symptoms: NATURAL INTENSE EMOTIONAL RESPONSE TO THE LOSS OF A LOVED ONE: Sadness, crying spells, longing, yearning, preoccupation with the deceased, and emotional pain
Secondary_Symptoms: Pining; Sleep disturbance; Transient auditory/visual illusions of deceased; Temporary withdrawal; Functional impairment
Typical_Duration: Months (gradually resolves; persistent complex bereavement if >12 months)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kisi pyare ke guzar jaane ke baad ye dukh shuru hua hai?; 2. Kitna time hua hai loss ko?; 3. Daily self-care kar pa rahe hain ya suicidal thoughts hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Non-Drug Support & Counseling FIRST-LINE (MEDICATIONS NOT INDICATED FOR NORMAL GRIEF)
Popular_Indian_Brands: N/A (No medication indicated for normal grief)
Supportive_Medicines: Bereavement counseling; Family and community support; Grief support groups; Rest
Precautions_Contraindications: NON-DRUG APPROACHES ONLY (BEREAVEMENT COUNSELING, SOCIAL SUPPORT, FAMILY REASSURANCE). Normal grief IS NOT A MENTAL DISORDER and must not be routinely medicated with antidepressants or tranquilizers. Antidepressants are Rx only if grief evolves into a formal Major Depressive Episode. Benzodiazepines should be strictly avoided as they dull natural emotional processing
Home_Care_Advice: Allow natural expression of grief and emotion without suppression; Lean on family, friends, and community support; Maintain basic self-care (nutrition, hydration, sleep); Join a grief support group
Lab_Investigations: Basic Medical Evaluation (if physical exhaustion occurs)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Active suicidal intent or self-harm wishes ('I want to join them'); Psychotic breakdown; Inability to eat or drink for days

Primary_Symptoms: EPISODIC MOOD DISORDER CHARACTERIZED BY ALTERNATING PERIODS OF MANIA/HYPOMANIA (elated mood, high energy, racing thoughts) AND MAJOR DEPRESSION
Secondary_Symptoms: Mania episodes: decreased need for sleep, grandiosity, risky spending/behavior, hypersexuality, pressure of speech; Depressive episodes: severe low mood, anhedonia
Typical_Duration: Chronic lifelong condition requiring continuous mood stabilization
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya aapke mood me extreme badlav aate hain - kabhi hafto tak excessive energy, bina soye kaam karna, bada bole bolna (mania) aur kabhi severe depression?; 2. Lithium ya mood stabilizer dawai chal rahi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (Mood Stabilizers - **Lithium** / Sodium Valproate / Atypical Antipsychotics - Quetiapine / Olanzapine / Aripiprazole)
Supportive_Medicines: Psychotherapy (IPSRT); Thyroid and Renal monitoring; Blood level monitoring (Therapeutic Drug Monitoring - TDM for Lithium)
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 1200 mg Lithium total daily / 1500 mg Valproate total daily
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required. ALL MOOD STABILIZERS REQUIRE STRICT PSYCHIATRIC SUPERVISION. NEVER STOP OR CHANGE THE DOSE ON YOUR OWN; abrupt cessation causes rapid manic/depressive relapse. **LITHIUM REQUIRES MANDATORY SERUM LITHIUM LEVEL MONITORING (Target 0.6-1.0 mEq/L), RENAL FUNCTION TESTS (CREATININE), AND THYROID FUNCTION TESTS (TSH) EVERY 3-6 MONTHS**, due to narrow therapeutic index and risks of lithium toxicity, nephrotoxicity, and hypothyroidism. Valproate is strictly contraindicated in pregnancy. Antidepressants used alone without mood stabilizers can precipitate acute manic switching
Home_Care_Advice: Maintain strict sleep-wake routines (sleep deprivation is the #1 trigger for manic switching); Avoid alcohol, caffeine, and illicit drugs; Keep a daily mood chart; Take prescribed mood stabilizers strictly at scheduled times
Lab_Investigations: Serum Lithium Level (MANDATORY 12 hours post-dose); Thyroid Profile (TSH); Serum Creatinine & Blood Urea; Complete Blood Count; Serum Electrolytes
Emergency_Red_Flags: LITHIUM TOXICITY WARNING: Severe coarse hand tremors, vomiting, diarrhea, ataxia, dysarthria, confusion, and seizures (EMERGENCY - STOP LITHIUM AND GO TO ER); Acute severe mania or suicidal depression

Primary_Symptoms: ACUTE PSYCHIATRIC EMERGENCY: ABNORMALLY ELEVATED, EXPANSIVE, OR IRRITABLE MOOD WITH SEVERELY INCREASED ENERGY LASTING >1 WEEK, causing severe impairment
Secondary_Symptoms: Profoundly decreased need for sleep (e.g., 2 hours sleep without fatigue); Grandiose delusions; Racing thoughts; Extreme pressuring speech; Reckless spending; Hypersexuality; Agitation
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Patient achanak hafto se bina soye excessive energy me hai, badi-badi baatein (grandiosity) kar raha hai, ya reckless impulsive kaam kar raha hai?; 2. Aggressive ya psychotic ho raha hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: None - emergency hospital referral
Popular_Indian_Brands: Injection Haloperidol 5mg IM / Oral Olanzapine 10-20mg / IV Sodium Valproate (in Hospital ER)
Dosage_Frequency: Immediate hospital ER admission for acute manic stabilization
Supportive_Medicines: Immediate ER / Psychiatric Inpatient Admission; Acute tranquilization / Rapid antipsychotic stabilization (Olanzapine/Haloperidol); Initiation of Mood Stabilizers (Valproate/Lithium); De-escalation
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Acute psychiatric emergency. DO NOT ATTEMPT HOME SEDATION OR RESTRAINT. Inpatient psychiatric hospital evaluation is mandatory to prevent physical injury, financial ruin, or severe behavioral collapse. Keep patient in a calm, low-stimulation environment during transport
Home_Care_Advice: Immediate emergency transfer to a hospital with psychiatric inpatient facilities; Maintain a calm, neutral tone; Reduce environmental stimuli (noise, bright lights, crowds); Do NOT argue with grandiose beliefs
Lab_Investigations: Serum Electrolytes; Blood Glucose; Toxicology Screen; Serum Lithium/Valproate levels (if already on treatment); Thyroid Profile; Non-Contrast CT Brain (rule out organic mania)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Emergency Red Flags: Severe exhaustion leading to physical collapse; Extreme physical aggression or violence; High-risk reckless behavior endangering life; Severe psychotic confusion

Primary_Symptoms: CHRONIC SEVERE MENTAL ILLNESS CHARACTERIZED BY PSYCHOTIC SYMPTOMS LASTING >6 MONTHS: HALLUCINATIONS (hearing voices), DELUSIONS (persecutory/paranoid beliefs), and DISORGANIZED THINKING
Secondary_Symptoms: Negative symptoms (apathy, social withdrawal, emotional blunting, avolition); Disorganized behavior; Anhedonia; Lack of insight into illness
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya 6 mahine se zyada se aisi aawaazein sunai deti hain jo doosro ko nahi sunai deti (hallucinations) ya bina vajah shakk/darr (delusions) rehta hai?; 2. Antipsychotic dawai chal rahi hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (Second-Generation Antipsychotics - Risperidone / Olanzapine / Aripiprazole / Quetiapine / Clozapine)
Dosage_Frequency: OD or divided BD under Psychiatrist
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Psychosis (CBTp); Social skills training; Family psychoeducation; Caregiver support
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 6 mg Risperidone / 20 mg Olanzapine / 30 mg Aripiprazole
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required. ALL ANTIPSYCHOTIC MEDICATIONS ARE RX ONLY UNDER PSYCHIATRIST SUPERVISION. NEVER STOP OR CHANGE THE DOSE ON YOUR OWN; abrupt cessation causes rapid psychotic relapse. Monitor regularly for Metaboilc Syndrome (weight gain, dyslipidemia, diabetes with Olanzapine/Risperidone), Extrapyramidal Symptoms (rigidity, tremors), and Tardive Dyskinesia. **CLOZAPINE REQUIRES MANDATORY WEEKLY COMPLETE BLOOD COUNT (CBC) MONITORING FOR AGRANULOCYTOSIS RISK**. Monitor for Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome (NMS - fever, rigidity, confusion)
Home_Care_Advice: Ensure continuous adult support and supervision; Help patient take prescribed antipsychotic medications strictly every day; Provide a calm, non-confrontational home environment; Engage in structured day programs and social rehabilitation
Lab_Investigations: Complete Blood Count (MANDATORY WEEKLY/MONTHLY FOR CLOZAPINE); Fasting Blood Glucose & HbA1c; Lipid Profile; Prolactin level; ECG (QTc interval check); Liver Function Tests
Emergency_Red_Flags: NEROLEPTIC MALIGNANT SYNDROME (NMS EMERGENCY): High fever, severe muscle rigidity, confusion, and sweating; Acute psychotic breakdown with violent/suicidal distress

Primary_Symptoms: ACUTE PSYCHIATRIC EMERGENCY (<1 MONTH DURATION): SUDDEN LOSS OF CONTACT WITH REALITY, presenting with acute hallucinations, severe persecutory delusions, and disorganized behavior
Secondary_Symptoms: Severe agitation; Unprovoked aggression; Extreme paranoia; Sleeplessness; Incoherent speech; Catatonia
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Achanak kuch dino me patient ka dimaagi santulan khoy gaya hai - aawaazein sunai dena, tez shakk, ya severe agitation hai?; 2. Khana/soona band kar diya hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: None - emergency hospital referral
Popular_Indian_Brands: Injection Haloperidol 5mg IM + Injection Promethazine 25mg IM / Oral Olanzapine 10mg
Dosage_Frequency: Immediate hospital ER admission for acute medical and psychiatric evaluation
Supportive_Medicines: Immediate ER / Inpatient Admission; Medical workup (rule out encephalitis, substance toxicity, metabolic encephalopathy); Acute tranquilization; Antipsychotic initiation
Precautions_Contraindications: Doctor prescription required; do not self-medicate; Acute medical and psychiatric emergency. DO NOT ATTEMPT HOME SEDATION OR PHYSICAL RESTRAINT. Emergency hospital evaluation is mandatory to rule out life-threatening organic medical causes (encephalitis, brain tumor, drug toxicity, metabolic breakdown) before diagnosing primary psychiatric illness
Home_Care_Advice: Immediate emergency transfer to a hospital with psychiatric/emergency facilities; Ensure physical safety of patient and family; Speak in short, calm, non-threatening sentences; Do NOT argue with delusions
Lab_Investigations: Emergency Urine Toxicology Screen; Blood Glucose; Serum Electrolytes; Complete Blood Count; LFT & RFT; Non-Contrast CT/MRI Brain; Lumbar Puncture (if encephalitis suspected)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Emergency Red Flags: High fever with confusion/rigidity (Encephalitis or NMS); Violent behavior or active suicidal/homicidal gestures; Inability to eat or drink; Sudden neurological deficits

Primary_Symptoms: PRESENCE OF ONE OR MORE PERSISTENT DELUSIONS FOR AT LEAST 1 MONTH, WITHOUT OTHER PROMINENT PSYCHOTIC SYMPTOMS (no prominent hallucinations, no flat affect)
Secondary_Symptoms: Persecutory/Paranoid delusions; Jealous type (Othello syndrome - belief partner is unfaithful); Erotomanic; Somatic; Grandiose; Functional capacity relatively preserved outside delusion
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya kisi ek baat par tez, bina kisi proof ke shakk (jaise partner par shakk, koi picha kar raha hai) 1 mahine se zyada se hai?; 2. Baaki daily kaam normal kar lete hain?; 3. Aawaazein to nahi sunai deti?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (Antipsychotics - Aripiprazole / Risperidone / Pimozide + Cognitive Therapy)
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Delusions; Individual supportive psychotherapy; Family psychoeducation
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required. ALL ANTIPSYCHOTIC MEDICATIONS ARE RX ONLY. NEVER STOP OR CHANGE DOSES ON YOUR OWN. Patients often lack insight and refuse treatment; therapeutic alliance building is essential. Monitor for metabolic side effects, weight gain, and extrapyramidal symptoms
Home_Care_Advice: Do NOT directly confront, argue with, or validate the delusional belief; Focus on feelings and real-world functional goals ('I see you are distressed, let's work on helping you sleep/feel safer'); Encourage adherence to psychiatrist visits
Lab_Investigations: Complete Blood Count; Fasting Blood Glucose; Thyroid Profile (TSH); MRI Brain (rule out organic delusional syndrome secondary to cerebrovascular disease or brain tumor)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Delusion leading to physical violence or stalking behaviors (Othello syndrome risk); Co-existing severe depression with suicidal ideation

Common_Names_Hindi: Postpartum Depression; Delivery ke baad udaasi
Primary_Symptoms: MODERATE TO SEVERE DEPRESSIVE EPISODE COMMENCING WITHIN 4 WEEKS TO 1 YEAR POST-DELIVERY: Persistent low mood, severe anxiety, and difficulty bonding with the newborn
Secondary_Symptoms: Profound fatigue; Excessive crying; Feelings of being an inadequate mother; Intrusive fear of harming the baby; Insomnia; Appetite changes
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Delivery ke baad se persistent udaasi, rona, aur baby se connection me dikkat 2 hafte se zyada se hai?; 2. Baby ko nuksan pahunchane ke intrusive khayal to nahi aate?; 3. Postpartum psychosis ke lakshan (aawaazein/shakk) to nahi hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Psychotherapy (CBT / IPT) FIRST-LINE + SSRIs (Sertraline / Paroxetine under Psychiatrist - Breastfeeding Guided)
Duration_Days: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (6 to 12 months)
Supportive_Medicines: Interpersonal Therapy (IPT); Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT); Mother-infant bonding support; Lactation-safe medication management
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 50 mg Sertraline initial / 10 mg Escitalopram initial
Precautions_Contraindications: Language must be completely non-judgmental and supportive. Psychotherapy is first-line for mild-moderate PPD. SSRIs (Sertraline is preferred in breastfeeding due to low infant milk excretion) are Rx only under psychiatrist guidance. Never stop or change prescribed doses on your own. EMERGENCY RED FLAGS INCLUDE INTENT/THOUGHTS OF HARMING SELF OR BABY, OR POSTPARTUM PSYCHOSIS (HALLUCINATIONS, SEVERE CONFUSION, PARANOIA - EMERGENCY HOSPITAL ADMISSION NEEDED)
Home_Care_Advice: Provide compassionate, non-judgmental family support and practical help with infant care; Ensure mother gets continuous uninterrupted sleep periods; Reassure her that PPD is a treatable medical condition, NOT a personal failure; Encourage expression of feelings
Lab_Investigations: Thyroid Profile (TSH - MANDATORY TO RULE OUT POSTPARTUM THYROIDITIS); Complete Blood Count (rule out postpartum anemia); Serum B12 & Vitamin D
Emergency_Red_Flags: POSTPARTUM PSYCHOSIS (EMERGENCY): Hallucinations, severe confusion, paranoia, or active thoughts/impulses to harm the baby or self (REQUIRES IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY ROOM HOSPITALIZATION)

Common_Names_Hindi: PMDD; Period se pehle ki udaasi
Primary_Symptoms: SEVERE EMOTIONAL AND BEHAVIORAL SYMPTOMS OCCURRING SPECIFICALLY DURING THE LUTEAL PHASE (1-2 weeks before menses) AND REMITTING WITHIN A FEW DAYS OF MENSES ONSET
Secondary_Symptoms: Marked affective lability (sudden mood swings); Severe irritability or anger; Depressed mood; Anxiety; Breast tenderness; Joint/muscle pain; Bloating; Severe functional disruption
Typical_Duration: Episodic recurrent (luteal phase of menstrual cycle)
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Period shuru hone se 1-2 hafte pehle severe udaasi, chidchidapan, aur ghabrahat hoti hai jo period aate hi 1-2 din me teek ho jaati hai?; 2. Ye cycle har mahine hoti hai?; 3. Daily life kitni disturb hoti hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: SSRIs (Sertraline / Fluoxetine - Luteal phase or Continuous dosing under Doctor) OR Combined Oral Contraceptive Pills
Dosage_Frequency: OD (Taken either continuously or strictly during 14 days of luteal phase)
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT); Calcium 1200 mg daily; Pyridoxine (Vitamin B6) 50 mg daily; Combined Oral Contraceptive containing Drospirenone
Precautions_Contraindications: SSRIs (Sertraline, Fluoxetine) and Oral Contraceptives containing Drospirenone are Rx only under doctor guidance. SSRIs in PMDD can be administered either continuously or restricted strictly to the 14-day luteal phase (from ovulation to menses). Never stop or change doses on your own. Drospirenone-containing OCPs are contraindicated in renal impairment, hyperkalemia, and high thromboembolism risk
Home_Care_Advice: Track symptoms daily using a 2-cycle prospective menstrual mood diary; Practice regular aerobic exercise; Reduce intake of caffeine, refined sugar, salt, and alcohol during luteal phase; Practice stress management
Lab_Investigations: Prospective Daily Rating of Severity of Problems (DRSP) diary for 2 consecutive cycles; Thyroid Profile (TSH); Complete Blood Count
Emergency_Red_Flags: Severe depression with suicidal ideation during luteal phase; Extreme rage or self-harm behavior

Primary_Symptoms: PERSISTENT PATTERN OF INATTENTION AND/OR HYPERACTIVITY-IMPULSIVITY ORIGINATING IN CHILDHOOD THAT INTERFERES WITH ADULT FUNCTIONING OR DEVELOPMENT
Secondary_Symptoms: Inattention: chronic disorganization, procrastination, losing items, failing to finish tasks, poor time management; Impulsivity: restless, interrupting, emotional dysregulation
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya bachpan se dhyan na tikna, kaam adhura chhodna, chizein kho dena, aur achanak bina soch-samjhe faisle lena (impulsivity) chala aa raha hai?; 2. Daily/job life kitni disturb hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (Central Nervous System Stimulants - Methylphenidate / Non-Stimulants - Atomoxetine)
Dosage_Frequency: OD (Morning strictly for Methylphenidate) / OD or BD (Atomoxetine)
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT for Adult ADHD); Executive function coaching; Organizational tools
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 20 mg Methylphenidate SR initial / 40 mg Atomoxetine initial
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required. ALL STIMULANT MEDICATIONS (METHYLPHENIDATE) ARE SCHEDULED RX DRUGS REQUIRING STRICT PSYCHIATRIC EVALUATION AND MONITORING. NEVER SELF-MEDICATE. Stimulants require baseline and ongoing Cardiovascular Screening (Blood pressure and heart rate monitoring); CONTRAINDICATED IN UNCONTROLLED HYPERTENSION, CORONARY ARTERY DISEASE, GLUCOMA, AND SEVERE ANXIETY/TIC DISORDERS. Atomoxetine carries a warning for suicidal ideation in young adults and hepatotoxicity risk
Home_Care_Advice: Use structured organizational tools (digital planners, task lists, alarms, calendar reminders); Break large complex tasks into small bite-sized steps; Minimize workplace distractions; Maintain regular physical exercise and sleep hygiene
Lab_Investigations: Comprehensive Clinical ADHD Evaluation (DIVA 2.0); Baseline ECG & Blood Pressure check; Complete Blood Count; Thyroid Profile (TSH)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Chest pain, severe palpitations, or dangerously elevated blood pressure on stimulants; Severe suicidal ideation; Psychotic symptoms

Primary_Symptoms: PERSISTENT DEFICITS IN SOCIAL COMMUNICATION AND SOCIAL INTERACTION ACROSS MULTIPLE CONTEXTS, COMBINED WITH RESTRICTED, REPETITIVE PATTERNS OF BEHAVIOR
Secondary_Symptoms: Difficulty with social-emotional reciprocity, non-verbal communication, and developing relationships; Highly restricted fixated interests; Rigid adherence to routines; Sensory hypersensitivity/hyposensitivity
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya bachpan se logon se baat karne, social cues samajhne, aur eye contact me dikkat hai?; 2. Kya ek hi routine ya khas interests me fixed rehne ki aadat hai?; 3. Sensory stimulation (light/sound) se discomfort hota hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Multidisciplinary Social Skills & Behavioral Support FIRST-LINE (NO MEDICATED CURE FOR ASD CORE SYMPTOMS)
Popular_Indian_Brands: Sizodon 1 (If co-existing severe irritability/aggression under specialist)
Supportive_Medicines: Social Skills Training; Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (for co-existing anxiety); Occupational Therapy (sensory integration); Environmental adaptation
Precautions_Contraindications: NO PHARMACOLOGICAL MEDICATION CURES OR TREATS THE CORE SYMPTOMS OF AUTISM SPECTRUM DISORDER. Pharmacotherapy (Risperidone, Aripiprazole) is Rx only under psychiatrist supervision strictly for specific co-existing behavioral symptoms like severe aggression, self-injury, or irritability. Never stop or change prescribed medicines on your own. Support must be affirmative and non-stigmatising
Home_Care_Advice: Provide clear, direct, explicit communication; Maintain structured daily routines and give advance notice before schedule changes; Create sensory-friendly environments (reduce bright fluorescent lights, loud noises); Utilize special interests for learning/employment
Lab_Investigations: Comprehensive Neurodevelopmental Evaluation (ADOS-2 / ADI-R); Audiometry (rule out hearing impairment); Genetic testing (if dysmorphic features present)
Emergency_Red_Flags: Severe self-injurious behavior (head banging, eye pressing); Acute meltdown with severe physical distress or aggression; Co-existing depression with suicidal ideation

Primary_Symptoms: PERVASIVE PATTERN OF INSTABILITY OF INTERPERSONAL RELATIONSHIPS, SELF-IMAGE, AND AFFECTS, AND MARKED IMPULSIVITY STARTING BY EARLY ADULTHOOD
Secondary_Symptoms: Frantic efforts to avoid real or imagined abandonment; Pattern of unstable intense relationships (idealization and devaluation); Identity disturbance; Recurrent suicidal gestures/self-harm; Chronic emptiness; Intense inappropriate anger
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya aapke relationships, mood, aur self-image me tez up-down (baat-baat par idealize/hate karna) aata hai?; 2. Abandonment (akela chhod jane) ka tez darr lagta hai?; 3. Recurrent self-harm ya suicidal gestures hote hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) FIRST-LINE (NO SPECIFIC FDA-APPROVED DRUG FOR BPD)
Popular_Indian_Brands: Nexito 10 (For co-existing affective symptoms under specialist); Quetipin 25 (For distress tolerance)
Supportive_Medicines: Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT - individual and skills group); Mentalization-Based Therapy (MBT); Crisis Safety Planning
Max_Safe_Limit_24h: 10 mg Escitalopram initial / 25 mg Quetiapine initial
Precautions_Contraindications: DIALECTICAL BEHAVIOR THERAPY (DBT) IS THE GOLD STANDARD FIRST-LINE TREATMENT. No pharmacological drug cures or is specifically approved for BPD. Low-dose SSRIs, Mood Stabilizers, or Antipsychotics are Rx only under psychiatrist supervision for co-existing affective dysregulation, impulsive aggression, or transient stress-induced paranoia. Avoid polypharmacy. Crisis safety planning is mandatory
Home_Care_Advice: Engage in Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT) skills training (Mindfulness, Distress Tolerance, Emotion Regulation, Interpersonal Effectiveness); Practice TIPP skills (Temperature, Intense exercise, Paced breathing, Paused muscle relaxation) for distress; Utilize a written crisis safety plan
Lab_Investigations: Comprehensive Psychiatric Evaluation; Basic medical workup (TSH, CBC, Glucose) to rule out organic causes of mood instability
Emergency_Red_Flags: EMERGENCY RED FLAGS: Active suicidal intent, suicide note, or severe self-harm attempt; Acute transient psychotic breakdown; Severe drug overdose

Primary_Symptoms: RESTRICTION OF ENERGY INTAKE LEADING TO SIGNIFICANTLY LOW BODY WEIGHT, INTENSE FEAR OF GAINING WEIGHT, AND DISTORTED PERCEPTION OF BODY SHAPE/WEIGHT
Secondary_Symptoms: Persistent behavior interfering with weight gain; Amenorrhea; Lanugo hair; Hypothermia; Bradycardia; Hypotension; Severe electrolyte imbalance; Denial of seriousness of low weight
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya aap khana lene se bachte hain aur weight badhne ka tez darr lagta hai?; 2. Kya wazan zaroorat se bahut kam hone par bhi lagta hai ki aap mote hain?; 3. Period aana band ho gaya hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - specialist supervision required (Specialized Eating Disorder Multidisciplinary Care + Olanzapine for weight gain/obsessiveness under Psychiatrist)
Supportive_Medicines: Family-Based Treatment (FBT / Maudsley approach); CBT-ED; Nutritional rehabilitation; Medical refeeding monitoring
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - specialist supervision required. DO NOT GIVE ANY CALORIE, WEIGHT, DIET, OR EXERCISE NUMBERS OR TARGETS. NO SELF-TREATMENT DRUGS. Pharmacotherapy (Olanzapine) is Rx only under specialist supervision to assist weight restoration and reduce obsessive distress. HIGH RISK OF REFEEDING SYNDROME (FATAL HYPOPHOSPHATEMIA) DURING INITIAL WEIGHT RESTORATION. Medical hospitalization required if severe bradycardia, hypotension, or electrolyte collapse occurs
Home_Care_Advice: Seek urgent specialized eating disorder multidisciplinary professional help; Do NOT restrict food intake, purge, or engage in compensatory behaviors; Ensure family-supervised structured meals; Maintain complete physical rest
Lab_Investigations: ECG (MANDATORY - check QTc prolongation & severe bradycardia); Serum Electrolytes (Potassium, Phosphate, Magnesium); Complete Blood Count; LFT & RFT; DEXA Scan
Emergency_Red_Flags: EMERGENCY MEDICAL RED FLAGS: Severe bradycardia (Heart rate <40 bpm); Severe hypotension (BP <90/60); Severe electrolyte collapse (Hypokalemia, Hypophosphatemia); Syncope; Active suicidal ideation

Primary_Symptoms: RECURRENT EPISODES OF BINGE EATING (eating abnormally large amounts with lack of control) FOLLOWED BY INAPPROPRIATE COMPENSATORY BEHAVIORS TO PREVENT WEIGHT GAIN
Secondary_Symptoms: Compensatory behaviors: self-induced vomiting, misuse of laxatives/diuretics, fasting, or excessive exercise occurring at least once a week for 3 months; Russell's sign (calluses on knuckles); Parotid gland swelling; Dental erosion
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya achanak bina control ke bahut sara khana khane (binge) ke baad guilt me ulti karna, laxatives lena, ya severe fasting karna padta hai?; 2. Kitne samay se ho raha hai?; 3. Tooth erosion ya throat pain hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - specialist supervision required (Psychotherapy - CBT-ED FIRST-LINE + High-dose Fluoxetine under Psychiatrist)
Duration_Days: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (6 to 12 months)
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Eating Disorders (CBT-ED); Nutritional counseling; Electrolyte monitoring
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - specialist supervision required. DO NOT GIVE ANY CALORIE, WEIGHT, DIET, OR EXERCISE NUMBERS OR TARGETS. NO SELF-TREATMENT DRUGS. High-dose Fluoxetine (60 mg/day) is FDA-approved for Bulimia Nervosa to reduce binge-purge frequency, RX ONLY under psychiatrist supervision. NEVER STOP OR CHANGE DOSES ON YOUR OWN. HIGH RISK OF FATAL CARDIAC ARRHYTHMIAS SECONDARY TO HYPOKALEMIA FROM REPEATED VOMITING/LAXATIVES. Bupropion is STRICTLY CONTRAINDICATED (high seizure risk in bulimia)
Home_Care_Advice: Seek specialized professional multidisciplinary care; Do NOT purge, induce vomiting, or use laxatives; Maintain regular non-restricted meals; Practice mealtime distraction with supportive family/friends
Lab_Investigations: Serum Electrolytes (MANDATORY - check for severe Hypokalemia and Metabolic Alkalosis); ECG (check QTc prolongation); Serum Amylase (parotid swelling); CBC
Emergency_Red_Flags: EMERGENCY RED FLAGS: Severe muscle weakness, cramps, or cardiac arrhythmias (Severe Hypokalemia emergency); Hematemesis (Mallory-Weiss esophageal tear); Severe dehydration; Active suicidal ideation

Primary_Symptoms: RECURRENT EPISODES OF BINGE EATING (eating rapidly, until uncomfortably full, when not hungry, alone due to embarrassment) WITHOUT INAPPROPRIATE COMPENSATORY BEHAVIORS
Secondary_Symptoms: Marked distress regarding binge eating; Occurs at least once a week for 3 months; Feelings of disgust, depression, or severe guilt post-binge; Associated with obesity
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya achanak bina control ke kam samay me tez-tez khana khane ke episodes hote hain, jiske baad severe guilt aur disgust hota hai?; 2. Kya aap ulti ya laxatives nahi lete (no purging)?; 3. Kitne mahine se hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - specialist supervision required (Psychotherapy - CBT-BED FIRST-LINE + Lisdexamfetamine / SSRIs - Fluoxetine under Psychiatrist)
Duration_Days: Rx - psychiatrist supervision required (6 to 12 months)
Supportive_Medicines: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy for Binge Eating (CBT-BED); Interpersonal Psychotherapy; Nutritional guidance
Precautions_Contraindications: Rx - specialist supervision required. DO NOT GIVE ANY CALORIE, WEIGHT, DIET, OR EXERCISE NUMBERS OR TARGETS. NO SELF-TREATMENT DRUGS. Psychotherapy (CBT-BED) is the first-line treatment of choice. SSRIs (Fluoxetine, Sertraline) or Lisdexamfetamine are Rx only under psychiatrist supervision to help reduce binge urges. Never stop or change prescribed doses on your own
Home_Care_Advice: Seek specialized professional eating disorder counseling; Avoid strict restrictive dieting (dietary restriction triggers binge urges); Establish regular structured meal times; Practice mindfulness and emotional regulation strategies
Lab_Investigations: Fasting Blood Glucose & HbA1c; Lipid Profile; Liver Function Tests; Thyroid Profile (TSH); Complete Blood Count
Emergency_Red_Flags: Severe major depression with active suicidal thoughts; Onset of purging behaviors; Acute severe GI distress

Primary_Symptoms: CRITICAL PSYCHIATRIC EMERGENCY: THOUGHTS, URGES, OR PREOCCUPATION WITH ENDING ONE'S LIFE, WITH OR WITHOUT A SPECIFIC PLAN OR INTENT
Secondary_Symptoms: DO NOT INCLUDE ANY METHOD, SUBSTANCE, DOSE, OR LETHALITY INFORMATION. DO NOT SUGGEST ANY DRUG. Active suicidal intent; Implicit or explicit statements of wanting to die; Giving away possessions; Severe hopelessness; Agitation
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya aapke man me khud ko nuksan pahunchane ya jaan dene ke khayal aa rahe hain?; 2. Kya koi plan banaya hai?; 3. Kya aap akele hain?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: "None - immediate crisis support"
Dosage_Frequency: Immediate emergency hospital referral and crisis helpline contact
Supportive_Medicines: Immediate ER / Psychiatric Inpatient Transfer; Continuous 24/7 direct adult line-of-sight supervision; Removal of all potential means of harm; Crisis Helpline Referral
Precautions_Contraindications: DO NOT INCLUDE ANY METHOD, SUBSTANCE, DOSE, OR LETHALITY INFORMATION. DO NOT SUGGEST ANY DRUG MEDICINE. FIRST LINE IS 'None - immediate crisis support'. Language must be completely supportive, non-judgmental, and non-stigmatising. NEVER LEAVE THE PERSON ALONE. REMOVE ALL ACCESS TO MEANS OF HARM IMMEDIATELY. TAKE THEM TO A DOCTOR OR EMERGENCY ROOM IMMEDIATELY
Home_Care_Advice: Emergency Home Care Protocol: 1. DO NOT LEAVE THE PERSON ALONE UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES; 2. Immediately remove all access to means of harm (medications, sharp objects, ropes, firearms, chemicals) from the environment; 3. Stay calm, non-judgmental, and listen empathetically without scolding or lecturing; 4. Take them immediately to the nearest hospital Emergency Room or Psychiatrist; 5. Contact National Crisis Helplines immediately: TELE-MANAS: 14416 (or 1800-891-4416) OR EMERGENCY SERVICES: 112 (Available 24/7 Toll-Free in India)
Lab_Investigations: Emergency Psychiatric & Safety Evaluation; Urine Toxicology Screen; Basic Medical Workup
Emergency_Red_Flags: CRITICAL EMERGENCY RED FLAGS: Active suicidal plan or intent; Presence of suicide note or final goodbyes; Self-harm attempt in progress; Severe agitation or psychotic command hallucinations

Primary_Symptoms: CRITICAL PSYCHIATRIC EMERGENCY: INTENTIONAL, DIRECT INJURY TO ONE'S OWN BODY TISSUE (e.g., cutting, burning, hitting oneself) WITHOUT EXPLICIT SUICIDAL INTENT
Secondary_Symptoms: DO NOT INCLUDE ANY METHOD, SUBSTANCE, DOSE, OR LETHALITY INFORMATION. DO NOT SUGGEST ANY DRUG. DO NOT SUGGEST PAIN-BASED OR SENSORY-SHOCK SUBSTITUTES (like ice or rubber bands). Wounds; Scars; Emotional dysregulation; Isolation
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Kya aapne khud ko chot pahunchayi hai ya aisi iccha ho rahi hai?; 2. Chot kitni severe hai (bleeding/wound)?; 3. Kya jaan dene ka irada tha?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: "None - immediate crisis support"
Popular_Indian_Brands: First Aid / Wound Care + Emergency Psychiatric Evaluation
Dosage_Frequency: Immediate medical first aid and emergency psychiatric referral
Supportive_Medicines: Immediate Medical First Aid / Surgical Stitching for wounds; Psychiatric Crisis Evaluation; Dialectical Behavior Therapy (DBT); Safety Planning
Precautions_Contraindications: DO NOT INCLUDE ANY METHOD, SUBSTANCE, DOSE, OR LETHALITY INFORMATION. DO NOT SUGGEST ANY DRUG. DO NOT SUGGEST PAIN-BASED OR SENSORY-SHOCK SUBSTITUTES (SUCH AS ICE CUBES OR RUBBER BANDS FOR SELF-HARM). FIRST LINE IS 'None - immediate crisis support'. Treat wounds with immediate medical first aid. Never scold, shame, or punish
Home_Care_Advice: Emergency Home Care Protocol: 1. Provide immediate medical first aid and wound dressing for any physical injury; 2. DO NOT LEAVE THE PERSON ALONE; 3. Remove all sharp objects and means of injury from the immediate environment; 4. Stay calm, compassionate, and listen without judgment, shame, or anger; 5. DO NOT USE PAIN-BASED OR SENSORY-SHOCK SUBSTITUTES; 6. Take them to a doctor or hospital Emergency Room immediately; 7. Contact India Crisis Helplines: TELE-MANAS: 14416 (or 1800-891-4416) OR EMERGENCY: 112
Lab_Investigations: Emergency Surgical & Psychiatric Evaluation; Tetanus Prophylaxis (for wounds); Complete Blood Count
Emergency_Red_Flags: CRITICAL EMERGENCY RED FLAGS: Deep arterial or venous bleeding; Wounds requiring surgical suturing; Ingestion of toxic substances or foreign objects; Co-existing active suicidal intent

Common_Names_Hindi: Afeem / Heroin ki aadat; Opioid Dependence
Primary_Symptoms: CHRONIC RECURRING BRAIN DISEASE CHARACTERIZED BY COMPULSIVE OPIOID USE (Heroin, Morphine, Tramadol, Codeine) DESPITE HARMFUL CONSEQUENCES
Secondary_Symptoms: Opioid Craving; Tolerance; Withdrawal symptoms upon cessation (mydriasis, lacrimation, rhinorrhea, piloerection, severe muscle aches, diarrhea, yawning, agitation); Social dysfunction
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Opioid (Heroin, Codeine, Tramadol, Smack) ka istemaal kitne samay se kar rahe hain?; 2. Dawai na milne par sharir me tez dard, loose motion, aur bechaini (withdrawal) hoti hai?; 3. Kitni quantity hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Rx - clinic-supervised treatment only (Opioid Agonist Treatment - Buprenorphine + Naloxone / Methadone / Naltrexone Maintenance under Registered De-addiction Center)
Supportive_Medicines: Medical Detoxification Support; Relapse Prevention Therapy; Harm Reduction counseling; Behavioral Therapy
Precautions_Contraindications: TREATMENT IS RX ONLY AND CLINIC-SUPERVISED STRICTLY WITHIN LICENSED DE-ADDICTION CENTERS. NEVER GIVE DOSES FOR ILLEGAL SUBSTANCES OR HOME DETOX PLANS. Buprenorphine/Naloxone sublingual combination is Rx only under licensed addiction specialists. Rapid home withdrawal can trigger severe dehydration and relapse. NEVER COMBINE OPIOIDS WITH BENZODIAZEPINES OR ALCOHOL (FATAL RESPIRATORY DEPRESSION RISK). Naloxone nasal spray is an emergency antidote for acute overdose
Home_Care_Advice: Seek professional treatment at a licensed De-Addiction / Addiction Medicine Center; Do NOT attempt unmonitored rapid 'cold turkey' detox at home; Engage in long-term behavioral therapy and support groups (NA); Ensure family awareness
Lab_Investigations: Urine Drug Screen (Panel for Opioids, Tramadol, Buprenorphine); HIV, Hepatitis B & C Screening (if IV drug use); LFT & RFT; Complete Blood Count
Emergency_Red_Flags: OPIOID OVERDOSE EMERGENCY: Unresponsiveness/coma, pinpoint pupils, and respiratory depression/apnea (REQUIRES IMMEDIATE EMERGENCY ROOM ADMISSION AND IV NALOXONE); Severe dehydration from withdrawal

Common_Names_Hindi: Ganja / Bhang ki aadat; Cannabis Dependence
Primary_Symptoms: PERSISTENT CANNABIS USE (Ganja, Charas, Bhang) LEADING TO SIGNIFICANT CLINICAL IMPAIRMENT, CRAVING, AND INABILITY TO CUT DOWN
Secondary_Symptoms: Cannabis Withdrawal: irritability, anxiety, sleep difficulty (insomnia/disturbing dreams), decreased appetite, restlessness, depressed mood; Amotivational syndrome; Paranoia
Clarifying_Questions: 1. Ganja/Charas/Bhang ka use kitne samay se hai?; 2. Chhodne par gussa, neend na aana, aur appetite kam hone ke withdrawal symptoms hote hain?; 3. Daily kaam par kitna asar hai?
First_Line_Generic_Drug: Non-Pharmacological Behavioral Therapy FIRST-LINE (Cognitive Behavioral Therapy + Motivational Enhancement Therapy)
